scope: Compact reproducibility package; excludes full 128^3 basis chunks, candidate caches, optimizer moments and duplicated checkpoints.

fd_laplacian.construction: 2048 scalar shapes x 3 tensor polarizations = 6144 candidates; one global generalized Ritz solve; retain 2048 complete vector modes
fd_laplacian.note: The FD-Laplacian basis is geometry-specific and is therefore archived as an exact reference, not exposed as a learned live geometry map.

live_protocol.boundary: squared transfer envelope; second-order boundary zero
live_protocol.render: exact checkpoint forward followed by compact finite-difference preview of u=div(A)
